newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end broadly stable in modest volume.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end broadly stable in modest volume.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed higher Tuesday, led by the industrial and construction sectors due to healthy prospects for economic growth this year, brokers said.
Players expect the same trend Wednesday, they said.
The General Index rose 0.26 percent to 2,158.9, while the blue-chip Selective Index climbed 0.52 percent to 3,098.6.
In a total of 1,990 trades, volume was 33.0 million soles ($12.5 million), brokers said.
"The investors have chosen brewery and construction company stocks as well as Telefonica (del Peru) to ensure themselves of gains over the long term," said Jorge Gutierrez of local brokerage Coril.
Benchmark Telefonica saw heavier trade than in recent sessions, climbing 2.23 percent to 6.89 soles on 994,000 shares.

Peru's largest brewery group Union de Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston SA gained 1.12 percent to 2.71 soles on volume of 2.1 million shares. The country's top cement company, Cementos Lima, closed up 0.39 percent to 5.17 soles on volume of 158,000 shares.
